## Selected work

```{=html}
<div class="work-grid">
<a class="work-card" href="rime.html">
<div class="work-status">Live &middot; deployed</div>
<div class="work-title">Rime</div>
<div class="work-meta">Daily ETF regime allocator &middot; Python, pandas, Alpaca</div>
<p>A daily allocator that splits capital between leveraged Nasdaq ETF exposure, a volatility hedge, and cash, using a shallow regime tree with a macro overlay and a volatility circuit breaker. Research and production call the same decision function, so live orders can't quietly drift from the backtest.</p>
<div class="work-more">Read the writeup &rarr;</div>
</a>
<a class="work-card" href="fifth-sanctuary.html">
<div class="work-status">Live &middot; deployed</div>
<div class="work-title">Fifth Sanctuary</div>
<div class="work-meta">Intraday gold volatility expansion &middot; Python, C#/NinjaScript</div>
<p>An intraday gold system running long and short as two separate risk sleeves, each sized by a macro state vector and filtered independently. The research found one sleeve was losing money structurally rather than randomly, which changed the design more than any amount of tuning would have.</p>
<div class="work-more">Read the writeup &rarr;</div>
</a>
<a class="work-card" href="project_kintoun.html">
<div class="work-status is-archive">Research &middot; Dec 2025</div>
<div class="work-title">Project Kintoun</div>
<div class="work-meta">ORB microstructure study &middot; Python, event-driven sim</div>
<p>A research notebook testing whether a break-and-retest microstructure filter plus VWAP trend confirmation can suppress false breakouts in Nasdaq-100 futures. Full methodology, math, and code are published, including where it doesn't work.</p>
<div class="work-more">Read the notebook &rarr;</div>
</a>
<a class="work-card" href="robotics.html">
<div class="work-status is-archive">2019 &ndash; 2025</div>
<div class="work-title">Green Lemons Robotics</div>
<div class="work-meta">FTC #16468 &middot; autonomous software, team leadership</div>
<p>Founded and led a 14-member competitive robotics team across six seasons, writing the autonomous control stack &mdash; vision-based navigation and path planning. Finished #1 OPR globally out of more than 8,000 teams at the 2024 FTC World Championships.</p>
<div class="work-more">Read more &rarr;</div>
</a>
</div>
```
